summary: Share Score feature testing completed. All 10 features tested. 9/10 passed. The Share button appears in Score Panel header, modal opens with backdrop blur, canvas scorecard renders correctly with score ring (12/100 'Weak'), 3 category bars (ATS Readiness, Recruiter Readability, Impact Strength), and branding. Download, Twitter, LinkedIn buttons work correctly. Close button (X) and backdrop click close the modal. Privacy note visible. One minor issue: Copy button doesn't show 'Copied!' confirmation in test environment due to clipboard API permissions - this is expected behavior in restricted environments.

issues: Copy button silently fails when clipboard API is denied - consider adding fallback to show 'Copied!' anyway or show error message
